info.title: zwave-bridge MQTT API
info.description:
Everything zwave-bridge publishes and accepts on MQTT.

Topics here use the default base topic, `zwave` (`mqtt.base_topic` in the configuration), and Home Assistant's default discovery prefix, `homeassistant` (`homeassistant.discovery_prefix`). `{node}` is a node id: 2 to 232, or 256 and up for Long Range.

The bridge publishes and subscribes at QoS 1. Payloads are JSON unless a message says otherwise. Requests go to `zwave/bridge/request/<name>`; the answer comes on `zwave/bridge/response/<name>` with `ok` and the result's fields, or `ok: false` and an `error`, echoing the request's `transaction` so a client can match the two. Network keys never appear on MQTT.

broker.description: Your MQTT broker: `mqtt.host` and `mqtt.port` in the configuration. The bridge connects with its `mqtt.client_id` and `zwave/bridge/state` set to offline as its last will.

bridgeState.description: The bridge's availability, retained, as plain text. `offline` is also the bridge's last will.

bridgeInfo.description: The bridge, its controller and its network, retained.

bridgeEvent.description: Inclusion, exclusion, security, interviews, firmware updates and SmartStart, as they happen. `event` names the event.

node.description: A node's record: protocol information, interview, security, endpoints, name and status. Retained; an empty retained message clears it when the node leaves.

nodeStatus.description: A node's status as plain text, retained; an empty retained message clears it when the node leaves.

nodeParameters.description: A node's configuration parameters from its device file, retained. Only with `[devices] dir`.

nodeValue.description: A value each time the node reports it, retained. A Multi Channel endpoint's value has the endpoint after the property, as in `binary_switch/current/2`.

property.description: The value's property, with `/<endpoint>` after it for a Multi Channel endpoint.

nodeValueSet.description: Set a value: switch, dim or turn on and off. For a Multi Channel endpoint the endpoint goes before `/set`.

property.description: The value's property, with `/<endpoint>` after it for a Multi Channel endpoint.

nodeRoute.description: The route the node was last reached by, retained.

nodeCommand.description: Commands the node sends that are not values: scenes, central scene key presses, unsupported reports.

includeRequest.description: Include a device. Answers when a device joined or listening timed out.

excludeRequest.description: Exclude a device. Answers when a device left or listening timed out.

grantRequest.description: Grant security classes to the joining node.

provisionRequest.description: Add a SmartStart device to the provisioning list.

unprovisionRequest.description: Remove a device from the provisioning list.

backupRequest.description: Back up the controller's memory to the store directory. The backup holds the network, so it is never published.

restoreRequest.description: Restore a backup onto the controller, converting it between 700 and 800 series. The bridge then exits for its service manager to restart it.

removeFailedRequest.description: Remove a node that no longer answers.

renameRequest.description: Name a node and give it a location.

firmwareUpdateRequest.description: Update a node's firmware from the firmware directory. Answers when the update ends.

configureRequest.description: Set a node's configuration parameters by key, from its device file.

topologyRequest.description: Ask every node for its neighbors, then read the mesh.

homeAssistantDiscovery.description: Home Assistant MQTT discovery: one retained config per value, sent the first time the value is reported after the bridge connects. Only with `homeassistant.enabled`.

object_id.description: The value's key with `_` for `/`, as `multilevel_sensor_air_temperature`.

SetPayload.description: A bare value, or one in an object.

anyOf.description: A level, 0 to 99, or 255 for on at the last level.

InclusionStrategy.description: How to secure a device being included.

oneOf.description: Grant every class the device asks for, without a prompt.
Include the device without security.

neighbors.description: Its neighbors in the controller's routing table.

route.description:
The repeaters of the last frame that reached it, from the controller
outwards; `null` until one did.

rssi.description: The RSSI of its last acknowledgement at the controller, in dBm.
